requirements.normative_requirement: The expensive micro-VM is persistent for a lease; it is not booted per tool call.
requirements.primary_verification: Warm-call benchmark and lease lifecycle soak.

requirements.normative_requirement: At most one writable lease exists for one source checkout identity.

requirements.normative_requirement: A lease becomes READY only after host confinement, boot transcript, TCB generation, semantic/rendered plan, image, storage, device, descriptor, and negative-canary attestation succeeds.
requirements.primary_verification: Fault injection at every handshake/canary step.
